topic: The Bridge Between Slopes and Areas: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus

sections.title: Prerequisite Warm-up: The Concept of Change
lecture_lines: Derivative measures the cat's instantaneous speed.
Integral tracks the cat's total distance covered.
Speed is slope; distance is area.
animations: Draw a blue point on the screen moving along a path #4287f5, represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png].
Fade in a grid background with thin gray lines #555555.
Show a horizontal slider below the path to control time #ffffff.

sections.title: Visualizing the Inverse Relationship
lecture_lines: Accumulating rate yields the original function.
Small rectangles create the growing area.
animations: Display two inverse curves in contrasting light colors #ff9800 and #00bcd4.
Show a connecting arrow [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg] rotating between the two curves #ffffff.
Highlight the intersection point with a flashing white circle #ffffff.

sections.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus (Part 1 & 2)
lecture_lines: Antiderivatives link slopes to total area.
Subtract boundaries to find net change.
animations: Draw a function [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/curve.svg] in light green #8bc34a.
Fill the area under the curve with a light yellow shade #fff176.

Animate the bound 'b' moving rightward along the x-axis #ffffff.
Show the resulting area value updating dynamically near the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/graph.svg] #ffffff.
